## 1. Minutes of the last meeting

The minutes of the meeting on 9 September were read and approved without changes. Proposed by Priya Natarajan, seconded by Owen Hughes.

## 2. Treasurer's report

Owen reported a balance of £3,412.60 after the autumn plot fees. Twelve of the 48 plots are still unpaid; reminders go out on 20 October.

| Item | Budget | Spent | Left |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Water | 900.00 | 742.15 | 157.85 |
| Tools and repairs | 600.00 | 418.40 | 181.60 |
| Harvest fair | 450.00 | 212.75 | 237.25 |
| **Total** | **1,950.00** | **1,373.30** | **576.70** |

## 3. Decisions

- The committee agreed to replace the leaking tap on the east path before the first frost.
- Plot 31 goes to the first person on the waiting list, Daniel Okafor.
- The harvest fair stays on the second Saturday of September.

> Decisions need a quorum of four committee members. Note who voted against if a vote was not unanimous.
